verdict: Leads are coming in; cost per lead is rising and needs correcting.
narrative: In the last 28 days, you received 49 leads across Meta and Google at an average cost per lead of $76.83 — up roughly 18% week-over-week even as total spend climbed 36%. The efficiency gap is being driven by Google: spend on that channel nearly doubled in the past week, but it produced only 12 conversions over the full 28-day window, including three consecutive days of spend with zero leads returned. Google campaign settings are being reviewed and tightened this week to bring cost per lead back in line. Meta continues to deliver the larger share of leads at a lower implied cost per lead, so budget allocation is being rebalanced toward what is working.
